previous_statement: Quantitative Neumann step: if J:X->Y is a bounded bijection with ||J^{-1}||<=4/3 and A:X->Y satisfies ||A-J||<=C_sp e and C_sp e<=1/4, then A is bijective and ||A^{-1}-J^{-1}||<=(8/3)C_sp e.
new_statement: Quantitative Neumann step for the present special corners (whose target space Y is Banach): if J:X->Y is a bounded bijection with ||J^{-1}||<=4/3 and A:X->Y satisfies ||A-J||<=C_sp e and C_sp e<=1/4, then A is bijective and ||A^{-1}-J^{-1}||<=(8/3)C_sp e.
